note: OMIM notes cerebellar tremor as a feature of SCA52 (RAB3A-related ataxia), making investigation of tremor frequency plausible.

evidence.text: OMIM lists cerebellar tremor among the clinical phenotypic features of Spinocerebellar Ataxia 52 (SCA52), caused by heterozygous mutation in RAB3A.

source.title: SPINOCEREBELLAR ATAXIA 52; SCA52 - Clinical Synopsis
source.quote: - Cerebellar tremor ... - Caused by mutation in the RAS-associated protein

evidence.text: SCA52 is recognized as an autosomal dominant neurologic disorder caused by heterozygous mutations in the RAB3A gene.

source.title: From genes to neuropathology: Integrative perspectives on the spectrum of spinocerebellar ataxias
source.quote: The most recent addition is SCA52, caused by heterozygous mutation in the RAB3A (Ras-related Protein) gene [8].
